title: 3D model animation generator
author: Need300dollars
selftext:
Does anyone know of an animation generator for 3D models? I have an idea to share for everyone. First, make a 2D video with AI, use Grok for example. It can be anything but needs to be adapt for mocap. Second, use this video in mocap software, let's say cascadeur. It will analize and give the animation you asked. But, there is a big issue, and it is that AI video generators are du*bs and don't make always what you ask, like an specific attack pose. Unless you make the pose first and then make the video from it, like Ludo.ai haves (great for this).

I recommend Ludo.ai for poses and animation. Hope this helps.

https://app.ludo.ai/sprite-generator

comments.body: I am trying to use it. Somehow, I don't know where to go. Hahaha, a little tutorial will do. But I like it. Would you be able to share it to [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com) so other users can also give their feedback?

comments.author: ChildOf7Sins
comments.body:
Trellis? https://github.com/microsoft/TRELLIS

I haven't had a chance to try it myself (I wanted to try getting it to run locally), but that's the tool I've heard of.

comments.author: WhatRedditIsAllAbout
comments.body: Yeah, you could check out hunyuan motion, just recently open sourced for a free local setup, or check Uthana out for quick free demo, but overall a paid platform if you scale. Both are semantic animation, so you are skipping the "middleman" step you described of having to generate a video animation, these options are typing description -- straight to animation.
